surface:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset for Reino Abissal, 2D dark fantasy game. Use ONLY image 1 (HQ17 Q3 v02) and image 2 (HQ17 Q4 v01) as WOOD MATERIAL references: colossal tightly braided dark woody roots, fibrous bark, charcoal and cool dark brown, very sparse subdued burgundy reflections, muted violet shaded recesses. Do NOT inherit the comic's camera, backgrounds, characters, tents, troops, portal, staff, lightning, text or red emissive specks. Match the approved direction of broad continuous woven root surfaces, clear dark woody sides and restrained detail.
Crisp pixel-art clusters and restrained dithering. Quiet low-contrast material for combat readability. Consistent very soft upper-left lighting; flat material texture, NOT cinematic illustration. No blur, neon, lava, embers, sparks, glossy white flecks, dirt, gravel, rocks, planks, paving, circular sawn-wood rings, checkerboard, regular crossed lattice, outlines, text, borders, labels, scale bars, UI, logos, people or creatures. Roots fuse tightly; dark seams remain filled wood, never holes through the supporting surface. No perspective projection baked into the top texture; the game applies its own 2:1 isometric projection later.
Deliver ONE square opaque 1024x1024 PNG material ATLAS. Fill the whole canvas edge-to-edge, without any margin. Exactly four equal 512x512 square tile variants arranged 2 columns by 2 rows, no separators or gutters. Each tile is a fully continuous TOP-DOWN woven ROOT SURFACE, mostly woody fibers flowing left-to-right with gentle twists. Four related organic variations with identical density, scale, palette and soft lighting. Macro strands made of fibrous wood, compact flattened interlocking bundles, not cylindrical raised logs or a cutout object. Seamless repeating edges within each tile: no dark border, corner vignette or bright seam on any tile edge. Tiles join to themselves; avoid unique giant focal knots that expose repetition. Opaque edge-to-edge wood, no transparent pixels, background, sidewall, void or external shadows. Subtle bark relief only.

Deliver ONE square opaque 1024x1024 PNG material ATLAS. Exactly four equal square 512x512 fully opaque TOP-DOWN junction fill tiles arranged 2x2, no borders, dividers, gutters or margins. ALL pixels are woody root material. In each tile, multiple broad FLATTENED fused root-fiber bundles flow together into calm low-relief braided wood. Four motifs: horizontal-to-vertical merging, three-way merging, four-way merging, broad relaxed interweaving. Root flow should dissolve softly into ordinary bark material near all tile edges, with no ring or circular pad. No actual island silhouette, high obstruction, hollow central hole, black gaps, cut trunk, sidewall, void or external shadows. This will be clipped to the approved junction geometry by the game; do not bake in a perspective camera or alter that geometry. Keep junction centers at least as calm as the passage texture.

Deliver ONE 1024x512 PNG with TRUE alpha transparency. Exactly four equal horizontal 1024x128 cells stacked top to bottom. In each cell, one long continuous woody ROOT SIDEWALL strip runs full width with no perspective or ground top visible. Straight flush upper attachment edge at the top of each cell; tightly fused dark roots descend a SHORT vertical distance, ending in an organic irregular fringe of a few finer hanging fibers. No horizontal branch, upper walkable ledge or new path. Sidewall darker than the top material, gentle violet shadow underneath, no cast shadow painted on an opaque background. Each strip must end by the bottom of its own cell and never overlap another strip. Alpha below the organic fringe, clean edges and no light halo; NEVER draw a checkerboard pattern. Four variations with matching scale and lighting, each horizontally repeatable, no numeric label or gap between cells. This is a flat material layer for screen-space extrusion, not a 3D scene.

Deliver ONE square 1024x1024 PNG with TRUE alpha transparency. A 2x2 atlas of four equal cells, no separators, labels or opaque background. Each cell contains only a restrained dark downward hanging root-fiber cluster for the VOID BELOW a suspended root edge: thin downward tapered strands anchored compactly at the cell top-center, descending vertically. Fibers are charcoal and nearly black muted violet, low contrast, substantially darker and simpler than the walkable root tops. Keep the four clusters isolated within their cells with clean transparent margins, no overlap. NO horizontal root span, platform, bridge, floor, thick sideways branches, skyline, scenery or support surface that could look walkable. No glowing dots, white haze, fog plane or background gradient. Short tapering subordinate ornamental fibers only. Soft material shading painted on the roots; alpha elsewhere with no white halo and no baked checkerboard. These are subtle static non-walkable depth accents, not new terrain.
